title: 2007 AMC 8 Problem 9
statement: To complete the grid below, each of the digits \(1\) through \(4\) must occur once in each row and once in each column. What number will occupy the lower right-hand square?

solutions.text:
The last square in the second row must be \(1\), since that row already contains \(2\) and \(3\), and the last column already contains \(4\).

Then the top-right square must be \(3\), since the top row already contains \(1\) and \(2\), and the last column already contains \(1\) and \(4\).

This forces the \(2\) to be in the bottom-right square.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Use the row and column restrictions to force entries one at a time.
Start with the last square in the second row, then move to the top-right square.
